checkedAlternates.risk: Toasted nori sheets look dark green.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Nori belongs to the red algae phylum Rhodophyta (group-3); its chlorophyll shows through only after roasting.

checkedAlternates.risk: Spirulina is sold as a bright green powder.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Spirulina is a prokaryotic cyanobacterium (group-1), not a eukaryotic green macroalga (group-2).
